plugins.Author: Boxu
plugins.Name: Skippy
plugins.Punchline: Allows you to skip a lot of categories of cutscenes, including MSQ Roulette Dungeons & Trials, Inn Login Sequence, Ocean Fishing and more!
plugins.Description: Skip all of the Cutscenes that bother you (MSQ Roulette for example) so you can actually play the game!
plugins.Changelog:
Global: (Bugfix) Fixed MSQ Roulette Cutscenes being skipped by using different categories.
Global: (Bugfix) Fixed Risky Skips from overflowing into other categories and being skipped without the user's approval.
Logger: (Bugfix) Fixed the delay and slowness of the plugin to connect/read/write with its datasheet.
Gold Saucer: Added Keybound Brawler to the options.
